text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we work. Automation now handles many repetitive tasks, from answering emails to organizing data, which saves time and reduces mistakes. Productivity tools powered by AI help employees plan their schedules, write reports, and make better decisions. However, AI is not replacing people completely. The best results come from human-AI collaboration, where machines do the fast calculations and humans bring creativity and judgement. Of course, these changes mean some jobs will disappear while new ones appear, so workers need to keep learning new skills. In short, AI offers great opportunities, but we must adapt to a workplace that is changing quickly.
